claims.claim: 50 original records; named input agrees with English manifest; all +0x22..+0x39 bytes match both ROMs and raw extraction.
Shared menu path uses unsigned low byte as percentage for every valid ID and selector 1..9; no type dispatch in stat arithmetic.

interpreted_values.division: signed integer truncation toward zero; floor for nonnegative inputs
interpreted_values.invalid_selector: skips coefficient load; no clamp/default proven

claims.claim: Two independent unsigned bytes per slot: percent and auxiliary. Original-loader auxiliary decoder depends on record type.
source_references: reverse_engineering/ghidra_loader_trace.md: instruction appendix; source and packed decoder

claims.claim: Auxiliary decoded values have no established gameplay quantity names in available traces.
claims.missing_evidence: Bounded consumers of RAM work+0x71 and +0x72, including type-specific action dispatch.

claims.claim: Ordinary menu adjustment preserves 1..7 from a valid initial selector; nine arithmetic cases exist. This is not a global state clamp.
Every full raw pair at slot 8 and 9 repeats slot 7; battle helper can add two modulo 256, with nine accepted battle indices.
Slots 8/9 are implemented; ordinary gameplay reachability and exhaustive exceptional/event paths are not proven.
claims.missing_evidence: Writers feeding Q+0x21/+0x23 and byte 0x03000C65, their connection to S[1], and evidence of normal flag activation.

claims.claim: Duplicate pairs could saturate a +2 battle-selector adjustment above selectable difficulty seven.

interpreted_values.conditional_examples: If Q[0x21]=d-1 and Q[0x23]!=0: d6 -> slot8, d7 -> slot9

claims.missing_evidence: Flag meaning and normal activation not traced; designer intent unavailable.

claims.claim: Upgrade writer truncates addition to byte before cap; M1 adds this state before percentage.
This conditional battle path reads the same percentage low bytes independently of menu cache, then subtracts a bounded target quantity and applies flags/minimum/suppression.

interpreted_values.post_subtraction: store low16; if R[0x27]&128 and BAF=2/3, scale signed16 by 80/70 percent; signed16<=0 -> 1; T.u16[0x0A]&0x4000 -> 0
interpreted_values.HP_store: 0x08046E02 target+0x0E; negative signed HP then zeroed

claims.claim: Universal all-Gimmick battle dispatch, persistent-upgrade transfer to Q+0x22, action flag semantics, and auxiliary effects are not established.
claims.missing_evidence: Action setup writers and per-Gimmick dispatch linkage to B1; no universal damage CSV values are inferred.

claims.claim: Previously user-reported Gear-Yo D1 U0 displayed Attack 26; battle pre-subtraction 26 minus 10 gave scratch16 and HP24->8. No new runtime execution.
Local coefficient/stat fields match both preserved ROMs; differing bytes in wider comparison windows are outside the menu body or in a graphics pointer.
Original type decoder is statically established; English unaligned word-load prefix should yield the same low-byte type under ARM7TDMI rotated-word behavior, without new hardware validation.
